issues: The transcript says e-file direct to IRIS is 'officially available' in 2025 release wave 2 and was also added to minor version 26.5. The page left this as unclear and did not mention 26.5. I set the status to GA and added the 26.5 detail to the summary and key points.

The feature named 'IRS portal A2A integration for on-premise users' contradicts the transcript. On-prem users do not get A2A; they create files and upload them manually. I dropped it, since the key points already cover the manual path.

The key point said corrections go out as a 'replacement transmission'. In the transcript, replacement transmissions are for fixing IRS errors. A correction sends only the lines marked 'needs correction'. I fixed the key point.
The transcript says email sending 'can protect' you and the vendor, not that it is encrypted. I softened the key point to match.
I dropped the quote at 33.5. It is a truncated fragment that adds nothing.
The 1086/1089 numbering is garbled in the captions, probably 1096/1099. The page follows the captions, which is acceptable.
